product_one_liner.value: Cast AI automates Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure resource management for DevOps and platform teams to reduce costs and improve performance.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL is a custom-quote request page, without published plans or prices.

named_customers.notes: Both appear on the homepage customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: Company-size band reported on its LinkedIn company profile.

eng_blog.notes: Under the strict two-post criterion, only one build-focused post by a verified engineer was established; a second qualifying engineer-authored post was not established.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal contains multiple guides, including CLI connection, console connection, Terraform, and workload-scaling documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A Senior Data Scientist posting is open and includes an application option.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, and Mistral
model_provider.notes: These are explicitly supported external providers integrated through AI Enabler; this does not establish which provider powers Cast AI's internal optimization models.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center lists SOC 2 Type 2, an ISO 27001 audit certificate, and PCI DSS AOC.

last_funding.notes: A strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures was announced January 12, 2026; its amount was not disclosed. The funding profile classifies the January investment as Series C. The reported valuation above $1 billion is not the investment amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 12, 2026 announcement disclosed a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An open Business Development Representative role in London includes an application option.

launched_6mo.notes: Cast AI announced its new AI India region in Mumbai on June 18, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page does not provide joining dates. Located executive appointment announcements were from 2024, so a change within the requested 12-month window could not be verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The GTM systems role names Salesforce CRM; the London BDR role names Clay and Apollo for prospecting.
